name: glyph-protocol
description: A minimal on-chain inscription protocol for the EVM
author: tunnckoCore

scripts.check: vp run fmt && vp run lint && vp run test && vp run build && vp run check:extra
scripts.selectors: methods=$(forge inspect GlyphKernel methods --json) || exit; if printf '%s\n' "$methods" | grep -Eq '":[[:space:]]*"(0x)?0[1-4][0-9a-fA-F]{6}"'; then echo "selector starts with a raw op byte"; exit 1; fi
scripts.snapshot: if [ -f .gas-snapshot ]; then exec forge snapshot --check --no-match-test testFuzz; else exec vp run gas; fi
